mobile.source_bridge: self-contained apps/mobile snapshot on the work branch; Production remains on vivizac/mobile until cutover

cutover_rules: Never reuse one Vercel project for both apps.
Do not change Production root directories before both app previews pass.
Keep current Mobile repository deployment active until apps/mobile Preview passes and the Production cutover is explicitly verified.
When either Vercel project uses its apps/* Root Directory, outside-root source access must be enabled so packages/common is available during the build.
Remove raw GitHub bridges only after both Production deployments are stable.
